svg.title: C06-M06-F1: How CSRF works and how tokens stop it
svg.desc: A flow showing an attacker page auto-submitting a state-changing request with the victim's cookie, accepted by the vulnerable app and rejected by the hardened app's CSRF token and SameSite cookie.
svg.text: C06-M06-F1 How CSRF works and how tokens stop it
victim logged in to app (cookie set). attacker page auto-submits:
vuln: server accepts (only checks cookie) -> email changed as victim
fixed: server requires per-session CSRF token the attacker cannot read
+ SameSite cookie not sent cross-site -> request rejected
Figure C06-M06-F1. CSRF rides the victim's cookie; an anti-CSRF token and SameSite
